Play virtual reality football like Kamil Grosicki! Watch Chary try and become as good as him in this VR soccer simulator.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=33RXAOKze1A&feature=youtu.be
[quote=Cas and Chary VR]
Turbo Soccer is a soccer simulator in VR, where you can feel like a world cup soccer superstar. There are three game modes: Striker, Replay and Goalkeeper. In Striker you are the one that have to shoot the ball in the goal while facing challenges and after beating each challenge it will get more difficult! In Replay you pass the ball to the defenders and put the finishing touch. The last mode is Goalkeeper where you have to save your team by catching the ball!
[/quote]

notes.title: New update - Patch #1
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32827196/ce1d84241e2ef4f3574e8fc3ed119e2bfdd24b5f.jpg[/img]

[h1]The most important stage of the World Cup is coming up![/h1]

The final phase, with grand finale in Moscow on June 15th has already begun. Unfortunately, the Polish national team had to say goodbye to the tournament, but our support for the team will last nevertheless.

Specifically for the knock-out stage we have prepared an update giving you the opportunity to play as players competing in the World Cup, who scored wonderful goals. 

Additionally, we have introduced smaller adjustments, which improved the looks and performance of the game.

[h1]New version of Turbo Soccer VR contains:[/h1]

5 replays from the first round of the World Cup:

[b]Russia vs. Saudi Arabia - 12th minute of the game[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32827196/bdcaf5a4c20aa5e19cb22cf637599545dec72780.jpg[/img]

[b]Peru vs. Denmark - 59th minute of the game[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32827196/8a6993873587fb0c1d6354fb6f64eb9d946c64fa.jpg[/img]

[b]Brazil vs. Switzerland - 20th minute of the game[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32827196/ee276b9259aa4b22af2a22758e0118f27f264482.jpg[/img]

[b]Germany vs. Mexico - 30th minute of the game[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32827196/c518aee8b002be541e368a74fa950f7aa4a5f6c5.jpg[/img]

Additionally:
[list]
[*]new replay menu with a notification tab informing about the match from which the replay has been taken;
[*]improved gameplay;
[*]optimized performance.
[/list]

Thank you for the warm welcome you have given to Turbo Soccer VR. Next week we will be releasing a new update introducing replays taken from the next matches from the World Cup in Russia.

notes.title: Turbo Soccer, a mobile game with Kamil Grosicki
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32827196/34ded4698b2dfc68869b22a2b64e8a303deb350c.jpg[/img]

Turbo Soccer today on all mobile devices with Android and iOS operating system. Kamil Grosicki is the face and the main character of the game. Player can control his moves by dodging sliding tackles from the defenders of the opposing team and shooting on goal.

[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dodo4story.turbosoccerm] Download Turbo Soccer[/url]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32827196/01ac2b27eeaf8d349547651920004987148c1cd6.png[/img]

Players will have multiple game modes to choose from, but scoring goals and progressing to next levels of the game will depend on their skills and reflexes.

Turbo Soccer is already available on Google Play and App Store.

Key features:
[list]
[*]Like on a real pitch - Camera located behind player’s back makes you feel like on a green football field
[*]Goal after goal - Dynamic action lets you play ball fast
[*]Be like Kamil - Speed up, dribble past defender and shot on goal!
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32827196/6d4f1d0095203a685b44d8771bc5cb2560b6bee5.png[/img]

Kamil Grosicki
Kamil Grosicki is one of the top players of the Polish national football team and English Championship club - Hull City A.F.C. Earlier he has played in teams such as Turkish Sivasspor or French Stade Rennais. Recently he has joined the team of Turbo Soccer VR, a new game utilizing virtual reality, produced by Dodo4Story Games.
